programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Jeffrey Home Alone. Ina is away for the night, so she prepares food for Jeffrey in her absence. Her one-pot beef stew is easy to reheat, and espresso ice cream is the ideal dessert. S7, Ep5

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Good Home Cooking. Ina's friend's daughter is studying hard at college, so she invites her and her two lovely friends to her home for some fabulous home cooked food. S7, Ep6

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Ten bakers remain and their bread making skills are put to the test. Judges Paul Hollywood and Mary Berry keep a close eye on the bakers who face three more difficult challenges. S2, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The showstopper challenge sees the remaining bakers attempt to bake and present a macaroon display that tastes as good as it looks. Who will be eliminated from the competition? S2, Ep4

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Mediterranean Adventure
programme.desc: Mainland Italy. The Hairy Bikers start their Mediterranean tour in the south of Italy. They try delicious local specialities like spicy n'duja sausage. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Nadiya Bakes
programme.desc: Classics With A Twist. Nadiya Hussain presents her recipes for classic bakes with a twist. Cupcakes given an ice cream-flavour and the classic scone is given an update. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Nadiya Bakes
programme.desc: Indulgent Desserts. Nadiya Hussain turns her attention to desserts. Nadiya starts off with a frozen, vegan no-cheese cheesecake with banana and blueberries. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: From North To South America. From a Houston joint's Argentinian empanadas to street tacos in Cancun, Mexico, Guy Fieri digs into flavours spanning the Americas. S26, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Goin' International. Guy Fieri grabs gangster global grub such as oxtail and curry goat from a Jamaican joint in Houston, and a 24-hour burrito hot spot in Cancun, Mexico. S26, Ep9

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: Security Issues. After complaints that their security guard is being too rough with customers, Dave and Mike, co-owners of Del Rossi's Cheesesteak Co. in Philadelphia, want help. S4, Ep11

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: What A Drag. Following complaints from his cross-dressing customers that the weekly quiz night is rigged, Bob, owner of Venture Inn in Philadelphia, suspects his manager is guilty. S4, Ep12

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Doll House, Joe's 50th, and Apple Drama. It's all gone mini as the team creates an amazing dollhouse out of cake. Grace is determined to decorate the cake for Joe's 50th birthday. S10, Ep13

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Massachusetts Madness. Guy Fieri ventures across Massachusetts checking out stuffed specialities! There's an Italian seafood feast and a gourmet sandwich shop serves roast beef. S15, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Handcrafted. Guy Fieri checks in on tasty eateries run by food fanatics in Memphis and Providence. He finds classic comfort food like meatloaf and home-cured bresaola meats. S15, Ep9

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Belly Up To Barcelona. Guy Fieri crosses the Atlantic to take a bite out of Barcelona! He visits a homely spot serving Galician-style octopus and tries old-school Catalan food. S26, Ep1

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Beef, Lamb And Pig. Guy Fieri hunts down meaty favourites in Kentucky and North Carolina. He enjoys an Irish pub's cottage pie, Asian-barbecue fusion and pimento-topped burgers. S26, Ep5

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Rehearsal Dinner. Ina helps a friend's daughter prepare for her rehearsal dinner. She provides two desserts to choose from - a rum baba and ile flottante with crispy praline topping. S6, Ep7

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Ladies Lunch. Ina hosts a lunch for local volunteers. On the menu is a fancy swordfish dish served with a saffron and courgette couscous. Plus, individual chocolate puddings. S6, Ep10

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Thank You Dinner. Ina helps a local shopkeeper host an end of season dinner for their staff. The French inspired menu includes Provençal soup and baked madeleines. S6, Ep8

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Long Distance Dinner. Ina creates a tasty meal for her medic student friend. She makes a flavoursome fillet of beef bourguignon, a cheesy courgette gratin and plum tart for dessert. S6, Ep9

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Jeffrey's Treat. Ina throws a surprise celebratory dinner for Jeffrey. She makes his favourite, French bistro food with a classic cocktail to kickstart the party. S7, Ep2

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa
programme.desc: Boss For Dinner. Ina invites her editor over for dinner with some new colleagues. She throws an Italian-American dinner with spaghetti and meatballs and for dessert ice cream sodas. S7, Ep1

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Ruth Davidson. Prue is joined by former Scottish Conservative leader Ruth Davidson, who cooks a childhood classic dessert. Plus, Prue cooks a Colombian soup. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: Michel reveals his recipe for poached cod with orange and vermouth. Later, he uses leftover croissants and brioches to make a tasty dessert. S1, Ep1

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: The Royal Scotsman. James's Scottish adventure starts in Edinburgh aboard the luxurious Royal Scotsman. Top chef Nick Nairn joins him to eat in its stunning dining room. S1, Ep17

programme.title: James Martin's: Island To Highlands
programme.desc: The Cairngorms. James heads to the stunning Cairngorms National Park. He's joined by chef pal Nick Nairn for a leg that includes whitewater rafting on the River Spey. S1, Ep18

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits Of The Sea
programme.desc: It's the Seafood Restaurant staff barbecue and the whole team gets together on the beach to have a great time. Rick, the boss, cooks a special, spicy red seafood curry. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits Of The Sea
programme.desc: Rick revisits one of his regular haunts in Australia and notices big changes in the county's cuisine. Then, he creates dishes that sum up the continent's culinary spirit. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Naples. He cooks the beautifully light pasta con vongole. Plus, he ventures to Suffolk and cooks cod with bacon and cabbage. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Goa to explore the ways they cook fresh fish. He cooks turbot vallée d'Auge. Plus, he visits Cornwall and cooks a Goan lobster masala. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Galicia, Spain to explore their seafood dishes. He cooks Almejas a la Marinera. Plus, he visits Leigh-on-Sea and cooks a cockle soup. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein returns to Goa where he cooks a shark vindaloo and dhal with lentils. Plus, he travels to America and cooks Hangtown fry. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Queensland, Australia. He cooks sautéed squid with salad. Plus, he ventures to Italy and cooks seared tuna with salsa verde. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Chesapeake Bay in America. He cooks pan fried bass served with succotash. Plus, he visits Thailand and recreates a tom yum soup. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein travels to Hua Hin in Thailand. He cooks a Thai stir-fry. Plus, he goes back to Cornwall and cooks fried fish with a red curry sauce. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein comes to the end of his seafood odyssey journey. He cooks Singapore chilli crab as well as a salt cod, chickpea and parsley stew. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Ruth Davidson. Prue is joined by former Scottish Conservative leader Ruth Davidson, who cooks a childhood classic dessert. Plus, Prue cooks a Colombian soup. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: From Australian To Asian. Guy Fieri is on the lookout for worldwide flavours. In Kauai, a Japanese-Hawaiian eatery is putting a quick spin on fish, burgers and burritos. S30, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Loaded, Stuffed And Fried. Guy Fieri visits joints loading it, stuffing it and frying it, from bison-gravy fries in Santa Fe, New Mexico to stuffed oysters in Kansas City, Kansas. S30, Ep11

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Pubs And Grub. Guy Fieri visits popular hangouts in St. Louis, North Carolina and Rhode Island. Dishes include gourmet grilled cheese and a porchetta masterpiece at a British pub! S15, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Swiss, Sandwiches And Sausage. Guy Fieri stops in Portland, OR, and Charlotte, NC, to sample grilled cheese sandwiches with a twist, schnitzel, sausage and Swiss specialities. S26, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Turkey, Taters And Dogs. Guy digs into a mashup of flavours, including a potato-centric palace dishing out hearty Brazilian specialties and a deli serving latkes and turkey pastrami. S26, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Burgers, Beef And Barbecue. Guy Fieri samples beef and barbecue in Florida and California, including a Vietnamese spot serving up tasty pho and a BBQ joint making a twist on lasagne. S26, Ep13
